**Triage: `domain:devx`; `Task`; `priority:p3`; `pm:queue`.**

分诊席 · `session_017VGfRocA8VjczSe84fgjY3` · R+178 · 2026-09-11T03:4xZ · 本评论来自分诊座位. objectui `origin/main` @ `58a4fada7c7a74c3c32628086f4a639c855ac5a8`.

### ⚠️ Premise re-check — the parent closed DURING this fire, which sharpens what this card is

Measured just now: **PR objectui#9105 merged 2026-09-11T03:39:44Z**, and **objectui#8991 closed `completed` two seconds later, 03:39:46Z**.

⇒ ⭐ this card is no longer 「a sub-case pending inside #8991」. It is the **standing record of the three members that round did not deliver**, and its parent is gone. ⛔ That is not a criticism of the close — the dev stopped and reported exactly as it should, and the report is this card — but it does mean nothing else is carrying these three.

### ⭐ Why `pm:queue` rather than the decision box

The card frames it as 「a decision rather than a fix」. ⚠️ Reading it, the decision it names has an answer that needs no ruling, and the alternative is measured shut:

- The three (`@object-ui/site`, `@object-ui/example-byo-backend-console`, `@object-ui/example-hello-world`) have **no test files anywhere**. Their root-config invocation exits **1**, and the card is right that this is 「the root config working as designed」 — it sets `passWithNoTests` to the negation of whether the CLI named test filters, so a positional path filter collecting nothing is exactly the case it rejects loudly.
- ⇒ adding `--passWithNoTests` would **manufacture** the agreement #8991's acceptance requires to be genuine.

⛔ **And that is the one direction this seat will fence rather than leave open**, because the board already carries the class: **objectstack#13799** — 「155 of 158 `scripts/**` self-tests have no assertion floor: **a battery that never ran is indistinguishable from one that passed**」. ⇒ giving three test-less packages a green `test` script is that sentence, chosen deliberately.

⇒ **Default direction, ⛔ veto window not a permission gate:** record the three as an **explicit, named exclusion** from the package-test-script class, with the exit-1 measurement and the reason, where the next person deriving that population will read it. ⛔ Do not give them a `test` script; ⛔ do not add `--passWithNoTests`.

⚠️ If the round finds the exclusion cannot be recorded anywhere a future derivation will actually read — ⇒ **stop and report**: that is a 「the carrier does not exist」 problem, and the answer is then a gate or a manifest entry, ⛔ not prose.

### Why p3

⛔ Nothing is broken: three packages with no tests run no tests, which is correct. ⛔ Nothing ships wrong and no user or author is affected. The cost of leaving it is that the **next** derivation of the package-test-script population re-discovers these three and re-asks the same question — which is exactly what happened to produce this card.

⇒ ⛔ Not p2: no deadline, no defect, no victim.

### Dedupe — run 2026-09-11T03:4xZ, 437-issue open `objectui` board

| pattern | open hits |
|---|---|
| `passWithNoTests` | **1** — #9106 |
| `8991` | **2** — #9106, #5748 |
| `zero-test\|no test files` | **1** — #9106 |
| `vitest` (control) | **27** |

⛔ **No duplicate.** **#5748** is a `pm:seat` post. ⚠️ Cross-repo, ⛔ not a duplicate and ⛔ not a blocker: **objectstack#13799** (`domain:devx`, `pm:queue`, p2) is the same class one repo over and is the fence cited above — whoever takes this should read it before proposing any green-on-nothing spelling.

`Size/model suggestion:` S — one recorded exclusion with its measurement. ⚠️ The work is finding the carrier that a future derivation actually reads, ⛔ not writing the sentence.

Readings on `origin/main` = `1e0e46af9`. ⚠️ ⛔ Every one is **conditional on the dev re-deriving it** — this seat shipped a ⛔ written from inference earlier this shift (objectui#9065, errata 43) and the rule since is that a premise goes out testable, ⛔ not as an order.

## ⭐ The measurement that changes what this round IS

Triage's direction is settled and this seat does not reopen it: **option A + a named exclusion**, ⛔ no `test` script, ⛔ no `--passWithNoTests`, on the ground that it would **manufacture** the agreement objectui#8991's acceptance requires to be genuine (objectstack#13799, 「a battery that never ran is indistinguishable from one that passed」).

Triage then said the hard part: 「⚠️ The work is **finding the carrier** that a future derivation actually reads, ⛔ not writing the sentence.」

⇒ ⭐ **there is no carrier. objectui#8991 landed none.**

```
git grep -ln "8991" origin/main -- scripts packages apps examples
→ examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/fields-vector/high-dimensional-vector.json
→ packages/plugin-gantt/docs/verification/23-i18n-chinese.png
```

Both incidental — a vector fixture and a screenshot. ⇒ objectui#8991 added **three `test` script lines** and **nothing** that derives, records or defends the population it derived.

⚠️ ⛔ Re-run that yourself before building on it. If you find a carrier this seat missed, ⇒ **say so and use it** — that is the cheaper round and this claim is wrong.

## What DOES read a manifest's `test` script — ⛔ and neither is a population derivation

| file | tests | what it is |
|---|--:|---|
| `scripts/__tests__/app-test-entry-8240.test.ts` | **7** | the **`console` app** instance — the `--project` mechanism objectui#9106 cites for `apps/site` |
| `scripts/__tests__/runner-package-test-entry-3746.test.ts` | **7** | the **`runner` package** instance |

⇒ two **per-instance pins**. ⛔ Neither enumerates the workspace and asks which members are in the class. ⇒ triage's stop-and-report condition is live: 「that is a 『the carrier does not exist』 problem, and the answer is then **a gate or a manifest entry**, ⛔ not prose.」

## ⭐ The precedent for the carrier's SHAPE is in the same family, and it already learned this exact lesson

`scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs`'s own docstring, verbatim on `main`:

> This docstring has been **WRONG about it once already** (objectui#5406: it asserted 「every per-package `vitest.config.ts` re-exports the root config」 while **eleven** standalone ones did not). It is now **ENFORCED instead of asserted** — `scripts/__tests__/vitest-invocation-guard.test.ts` **walks the repo and fails** on any config taking none of the routes below. **Read that test, not this paragraph, for what is true today.**

That test holds **37** tests today.

⇒ ⭐ **a prose exclusion is the thing objectui#5406 proved does not hold, in this very file, about this very subject.** ⚠️ ⛔ This seat is ⛔ not handing you a design — it is handing you the precedent, and the one property it suggests:

⭐ **an exclusion that cannot EXPIRE is the same defect one level up.** If `examples/hello-world` gains a test file tomorrow and stays on the excluded list, the exclusion has become the silent false green it was written to prevent. ⇒ whatever carries it should be able to go **red in both directions** — a new zero-test member appearing, and a listed member ceasing to be one.

## Premises — ⛔ each yours to re-run

| reading | value on `1e0e46af9` |
|:--|--:|
| files naming `8991` under `scripts`/`packages`/`apps`/`examples` | **2**, both incidental |
| per-instance `test`-script pins | **2** (`8240`, `3746`) |
| `vitest-invocation-guard.test.ts` tests | **37** |
| `packages/layout` · `packages/test-support` · `examples/console-starter` | each `vitest run --root ../.. <dir>/` |
| `apps/site` · `examples/byo-backend-console` · `examples/hello-world` | **no `test` script** (literally absent) |

⛔ The card's three exit-1 measurements (`pnpm exec vitest run apps/site/` etc.) are **not** re-measured here — ⇒ they are yours, and they are the load-bearing ones.

## ⛔ Fences

- ⛔ **No `test` script for the three. ⛔ No `--passWithNoTests`.** Triage's ruling, and the reason is measured, ⛔ not stylistic.
- ⛔ **Do not give `apps/site` a `--project` entry** (option D). It needs a `site` project in the root config first — a larger change than this card, and ⛔ not ruled.
- ⛔ Do not touch objectui#8991's three landed entries. They are correct.
- ⚠️ `.claude/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` are the governed surface — ⛔ not a carrier this seat can land.
- ⚠️ Another `os-dev` is on `.github/prompts/component.prompt.md` + `scripts/check-prompt-component-keys.mjs` (objectui#9098). PR objectui#9141 (objectui#9096) is **held draft** and owns `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` + `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. ⛔ Stay out of all four.
- ⚠️ ⭐ **If your carrier is a new file under `scripts/__tests__/`**, it becomes a markdown-test-input candidate the moment objectui#9141 lands. ⛔ Not a blocker and ⛔ not yours to coordinate — recorded so it is not a surprise.
